task_description: Complete overhaul of QuantFeed: fix data freshness (remove fake mock dates, add recency-weighted scoring, topic correlation algorithm), upgrade 3D graph interaction (hover tooltips, click detail panel with Visit Article link, node image on zoom, edge highlighting, related nodes), and premium visual design upgrade (Bloomberg Terminal meets Apple aesthetic).

verification.summary: `bun run next build` compiles successfully and generates all 11 pages/routes. No test framework exists in this project (verification is build-only per project conventions); the two webpack warnings are benign next/font cache-resolution warnings pre-existing and unrelated to these changes. The two lint warnings (next/no-img-element on the intentional onError-capable , exhaustive-deps on the intentional cache-reset useMemo) are documented acceptable tradeoffs. No Dockerfile present, so docker_build skipped. Semantic review reached APPROVED on v3 after 3 review iterations.
